using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public class ReplicaSyncSessionTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task AcquireCheckpointEntryAsync_LogsInformationWithIteration()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var mockStoreWrapper = new Mock<StoreWrapper>();
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();

            // We create a minimal ReplicaSyncSession instance with logger injected
            var session = new ReplicaSyncSession(
                mockStoreWrapper.Object,
                mockClusterProvider.Object,
                logger: mockLogger.Object);

            // Act
            // Call AcquireCheckpointEntryAsync once to trigger the log call on iteration 0
            var task = session.AcquireCheckpointEntryAsync();

            // Await the task to complete
            await task;

            // Assert
            // Verify that LogInformation was called with the expected message and iteration 0
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("AcquireCheckpointEntry iteration 0")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.AtLeastOnce);
        }
    }
}

using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public class ReplicaSyncSessionTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task AcquireCheckpointEntryAsync_LogsInformationWithIteration()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var mockStoreWrapper = new Mock<StoreWrapper>(null, null);
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>(null);

            // We cannot call the internal constructor directly, so we use reflection to create an instance
            var sessionType = typeof(ReplicaSyncSession);
            var ctor = sessionType.GetConstructors(System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)[0];
            var session = (ReplicaSyncSession)ctor.Invoke(new object[]
            {
                mockStoreWrapper.Object,
                mockClusterProvider.Object,
                null, // replicaSyncMetadata
                default, // CancellationToken
                null, // replicaNodeId
                null, // replicaAssignedPrimaryId
                null, // replicaCheckpointEntry
                0L, // replicaAofBeginAddress
                0L, // replicaAofTailAddress
                mockLogger.Object
            });

            // Act
            // Call AcquireCheckpointEntryAsync once to trigger the log call on iteration 0
            var task = (Task<(CheckpointEntry, AofSyncTaskInfo)>)sessionType.GetMethod("AcquireCheckpointEntryAsync", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance).Invoke(session, null);

            await task;

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Information,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("AcquireCheckpointEntry iteration 0")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, System.Exception, string>>()),
                Times.AtLeastOnce);
        }
    }
}
